name: Glass Car Dash
tagline: Live MPH speed and head-nod break reminders
description: Live phone GPS speed with the Silverline gauge. Learns your normal head pose automatically and watches for the microsleep pattern: a still head, a slow forward droop, then a quick snap back up. Two such nods within a minute trigger a Take a break warning; talking, deliberate nods, glances, bumps and hard braking are ignored. Status appears only on the phone. Tap to dismiss; double-tap to exit. This motion heuristic does not confirm drowsiness.
author: Usman Kayani

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Uses your phone’s GPS to show current speed in miles per hour.
